science: University of Queensland scientists make fresh progress in quantum computing research
sports: Queensland NRL sides gear up as the spring finals series kicks off
stories.overview: Rare pygmy blue whale sighting off the Sunshine Coast has locals and scientists buzzing

segments.title: Green Desk
segments.script: First up, some genuinely lovely news from out on the water. Researchers have reported encouraging signs of coral recovery on parts of the Great Barrier Reef in the latest health survey, which is the kind of update we love leading with. Yeah it's not all doom and gloom out there, the reef's a tough old thing and it's showing some real resilience. Doesn't mean we stop looking after it, but it's a nice reminder that recovery is possible when we give nature half a chance. Speaking of giving nature a hand, volunteers right across Queensland have been out this week planting thousands of native trees as part of a spring bushland restoration push. Community groups getting their hands dirty for a good cause, you love to see it.

segments.title: Science & Tomorrow
segments.script: Now let's swing over to the science pillar, and this one's a bit of a brain bender. Boffins at the University of Queensland reckon they've made fresh progress on quantum computing, which is basically computers that think in riddles. I still don't fully understand quantum computing Alex, but I'm told it could eventually help with everything from medicine to climate modelling. Big call for a bunch of researchers in a lab in Brisbane, but that's our lot, punching above our weight. That's the Queensland way, punch above your weight and be home for dinner. Great stuff from the UQ team, we'll keep an eye on where that research heads next.

segments.title: Weather
segments.script: Cheers Alex, good to be with you both this morning. It's shaping up as a proper spring week across the south east, plenty of sunshine on the cards for Brisbane, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast with daytime temps sitting in the mid to high twenties. We might see a few afternoon clouds build up inland as the warmth kicks the atmosphere into gear, but nothing to worry the weekend plans just yet, just keep the brolly handy toward the end of the week. Back to you two, enjoy the sunshine out there.

segments.title: The Scoreboard
segments.script: Righto, let's talk footy because the NRL finals series is finally here and Queensland's got skin in the game. It's that time of year where every tackle feels like it matters twice as much, and the fans up here are loving it. There's nothing like finals footy energy, is there? Pubs are packed, backyards are loud, and everyone's suddenly an expert on the ruck rate. Truer words never spoken Jamie. Whoever gets through, it's shaping up as a cracking finals series, and we'll keep bringing you the good news angle, because there's always a good news angle in footy if you look hard enough.
